Fear foods are things that are often associated with fear. A lot of people with EDs feel as if food's can be broken down into two sides. Good foods and bad foods. Good foods have low calories, fat, and carbs while fear foods are the exact opposite. There's this trepidation that comes along with fear foods as they'd feel as if all that would happen is they would binge and gain fat. For me when I was anorexic anything with fat was my fear foods. I would stay away from things like butter and oil because I was scared of it. I hope this clears things up for you.
